I've added this to a deckofmine and now a thousand questions arise.

1 - If card text states "tap and put a counter on it" when we use the
remover do we put a counter in it too?

2 - I annouce the action of tapping a card, but some cards (like "The
Coven") can be used any time. what happends? Does the other played has
sucess using the the card(if so what happends to my action?) or is he
unable to use it until my action resolves?

body of the message, too. It's good for searching archives of
messages, as well as adds clarity.

So, on to the questions about Remover.

>I've added this to a deckofmine and now a thousand questions arise.
>
>1 - If card text states "tap and put a counter on it" when we use the
>remover do we put a counter in it too?

No.
Similarly, when you tap Mariel, Lady Thunder to announce her taking an
action, you don't suddenly fling a damage on a pair of minions
somehow.

>2 - I annouce the action of tapping a card, but some cards (like "The
>Coven") can be used any time. what happends? Does the other played has
>sucess using the the card(if so what happends to my action?) or is he
>unable to use it until my action resolves?

They are allowed to tap their card in response to acheive their
desired result. Once your Remover action comes to resolve, it will
still resolve, as tapping a tapped card is perfectly legal (result is
usually 'nothing', but sometimes it has it's uses) and Remover doesn't
require you to choose an untapped card.

Remover [BH:C]
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Put this card on a Black Hand vampire. This vampire can tap any card
(including a minion) as a +1 stealth (D) action. A vampire can have
only one Remover.
